newsitem.title: USA: Penn Advertising looks at IPO or sale of company.
newsitem.headline: Penn Advertising looks at IPO or sale of company.

text.p: Penn Advertising said Tuesday it hired Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette to assist the company in exploring alternatives, including the sale of the company or an initial public offering of its stock.

The company, one of the leading outdoor advertising companies in the Northeast, explained that: "Penn's Board of Directors has engaged DLJ in response to the current equity market receptivity to the outdoor advertising sector as well as significant acquisition activity, most recently the Gannett and Peterson sales."

Noting it "has accomplished its strategic objectives, including the successful implementation of a regional sales program which has grown and diversified our revenue base," management said "We believe that the company offers an attractive acquisition platform due to its geographic concentration and market presence.
"A merger with a strategic acquirer could create significant economies of scale," it added.
